title: White Eye
program: Louis le Prince International Short Film Competition
description: A man locates his stolen bicycle but it now appears to be in the ownership of an absolute stranger. He attempts to retrieve the bike but finds himself caught up in a web of miscommunication and mistrust. Is it possible for him to remain humane?
cast: Dawit Tekelaeb A mother in Tehran has an errand to run in a shopping mall. Leaving her daughter outside in the car
she quickly finds herself helping an elderly woman. A tragedy occurs
brutally confronting her with the impact of her actions.
